title: Reference-network validation
summary: Public 9-bus benchmark; synthetic wind at bus 6. Original voltage, branch and generator limits preserved. All declared checks passed in both default cases and 21 confirmation cases.
scope: Steady-state N0 snapshot; no field validation or full N-1 security.
independent_method: Flat-start SciPy root with independently coded direct branch-current equations.
limitations: This is a synthetic benchmark scenario, not an Irish reduction measurement.
Topology availability is assumed; real outage permission is not established.
Local AC OPF solution; no proof of global optimality.
No EUR cost or annual MWh claim.
